description: Fault injection over lru_eviction_bug's fixtures (context_from): the harness deterministically rejects the first submit_review with a generic could-not-verify reason. Grades recovery: after one rejection the model must promptly resubmit a complete, valid, non-placeholder artifact instead of degrading (the live failure this scenario is modelled on ended in {"summary": "test", "findings": []}, which min_findings rules out). The injected reason is deliberately generic: false specifics about a valid artifact gaslight the model into actually dropping the named keys, inducing the spiral rather than testing recovery from one.
line_accuracy_note: Exact line 24, same defect as lru_eviction_bug (context_from). The model reads a diff whose lines are prefixed with their new-file numbers (artifact.annotate_diff), so the anchor is a copy rather than a calculation; measured 4/4 exact on every scenario. If this starts failing, look at the annotation or the prompt — do not widen it.
diagnosis_note: body_contains_any is lru_eviction_bug's, since the planted defect is the same one (context_from). The recovery property is about resubmitting a COMPLETE artifact, so the artifact still has to carry the diagnosis.
